changes.text: classiccharacters 005 (session 86, the user: raids and the week reset "overnight from Sunday to Monday. Around 3AM", Brazil time; the classic short cycles kept). The core keeps each raid's reset day and only moves the hour, so: the 7-day raids (Molten Core 409, Blackwing Lair 469, Temple of Ahn'Qiraj 531, Naxxramas 533) from Sunday 2026-10-18 01:00 to Monday 2026-10-19 03:00 (06:00 UTC; Instance.ResetTimeHour counts in UTC); the honor week's next calculation and the weekly quests' next reset to the same Monday (NextMaintenanceDate = year << 16 | day of year). Onyxia, Zul'Gurub, AQ20 and UBRS keep their 5- and 3-day cycles: the server moves their hour to 03:00 at start. Apply with the world server stopped.
